Product Features

  • Wall-mounted design: The wall-mounted design saves space! Measuring 180 x 37 x 36 cm, it's suitable for 75-inch TVs and features a contrasting natural wood finish with black and a high-gloss front. It can be easily and stylishly installed on the wall in your living room.
  • Three-tier design: The three-tier layout is incredibly practical, with cabinet doors on both sides, a large storage cabinet in the middle, and dividers for layered storage. Game consoles, set-top boxes, and remote controls all have their place, making living room clutter easily "invisible" and keeping things tidy.
  • High-gloss design: The high-gloss front and contrasting color scheme make it a stylish addition to a minimalist living room. The warmth of the natural wood softens the stark black. When the LED light is switched on, it appears understated during the day and warm at night, its appearance changing with the surroundings. (The highlighting effect is limited to the front.)
  • Downward-folding door design: The downward-folding door design is full of ingenuity! The semi-enclosed cabinet door opens and closes easily, and you don't have to bend down to retrieve items from the middle shelf. It's practical for everyday use, and the thoughtful considerations for life are hidden in the details.
  • LED light strips: The mobile app controls the LED lights, creating a fantastic atmosphere. Adjust the warm yellow ambient light while watching a movie to intensify the drama. Switch to colored light strips for your party and your TV wall instantly transforms into an "atmosphere wall." It's extremely flexible and can be adapted to various scenes.
  • Durable material: The chipboard is robust and durable, with a total load-bearing capacity of 60 kg. A 75-inch television will sit securely on it and won't wobble, even when filled with decorative items. It's long-lasting, provides a sense of security, and will be a long-lasting addition to your home.
  • Easy to clean: Thanks to wall mounting, you're no longer restricted by the floor; the robotic cleaner can move freely and clean every corner, and you no longer need to move the TV cabinet for cleaning. It's a "miracle weapon" for lazy people, preventing cleaning problems.
  • Practical storage: The dividers of the middle storage cabinet are tiered; the top shelf is for frequently read books and decorative paintings, and the bottom shelf is for rarely used items. The storage layout is clear and organized, so you don't have to search blindly for things, and the living room storage is well-organized.
  • USB powered – Comes with a 5V 2A USB cable (USB plug not included) that can be connected to your TV, computer, power bank, etc. Safe and easy to use indoors.
  • NOTE: This product consists of two packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please ensure both packages have arrived before beginning assembly!
